metadataHeadRule: Only .depulse-certification is excluded by the canonical source fingerprint. Resume/evidence checkpoints there may advance operationally after a candidate commit. handoff/CURRENT.md is source-fingerprinted and must freeze with the product before G11.

G10.required: Fresh canonical Fast + Qualified PASS on the final source-fingerprinted handoff/candidate with reconciled excluded checkpoints.

G11.required: Freeze exact v18.6.0 source SHA and canonical Git-object fingerprint.

G13-G14-macOS-Apple-Silicon.required: Native package, provenance binding, and actual packaged runtime audit.

G13-G14-Windows-x64.required: Native package, provenance binding, and actual packaged runtime audit.

G15.required: Bind both native evidence graphs and promote already-certified artifacts without rebuild.

G16.required: Durable adaptive retrospective and handoff after G15.

residuals: TradeInsight remains governed future/shadow work until separately validated and approved.
